content:
Recently, a batch of Suzhou King Long Higer New V Series pure electric buses was shipped to Ethiopia, empowering the low-carbon upgrade of African public transportation with green intelligent manufacturing.

## Batch Delivery of Higer Pure Electric Buses to Ethiopia

Since its launch, the Higer New V Series has quickly become a popular model in domestic and international highway passenger transport, with cumulative sales exceeding 10,000 units. This model is not only widely deployed in many domestic locations such as Beijing, Shanghai, Chongqing, Lijiang, and Luoyang, but is also exported to more than twenty countries and regions worldwide, including Italy, the Philippines, Qatar, and Algeria.
